case.title: Beginning and Intermediate Algebra
case.author: Tyler Wallace
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF. The title and license pages identify Tyler Wallace and the author website. No automated source download or publisher-byte equivalence is claimed.
case.rightsBasis: Page 2 states Copyright 2010 Tyler Wallace and Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. The PDF remains an external local corpus source; it is not bundled or relicensed under MIT.
case.attribution: Beginning and Intermediate Algebra by Tyler Wallace, copyright 2010, CC BY 3.0. Source: http://wallace.ccfaculty.org/book/book.html. The supplied PDF is unmodified.
case.reviewStatus: 11 pages prepared for comparison. Visual spot checks cover pages 16, 343, 347 and 479; not full-book fidelity qualification.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 release CLI, library defaults; initial per-document regression ceiling with headroom above the measured baseline, not an iOS memory guarantee

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Inline superscript flattens into baseline text: the introductory ax-squared expression is serialized as ax2, without superscript markup. The displayed derivation is retained as an image, so passing EPUB validation and preserving displayed math do not establish inline-math fidelity.

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
